args: export $(grep -E '^LANGFUSE_(PUBLIC_KEY|SECRET_KEY|BASE_URL)=' apps/translator/.env | xargs) && AUTH="Basic $(printf '%s' "$LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY:$LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY" | base64 | tr -d '\n')" && exec npx -y mcp-remote "${LANGFUSE_BASE_URL:-https://cloud.langfuse.com}/api/public/mcp" --transport http-only --header "Authorization:$AUTH"
